results.teaser: SAN DIEGO – Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, also known as “Chapo Isidro,” an alleged leader of the Sinaloa Cartel, has been captured by the Mexican military following a Homeland Security Task Force Investigation. Meza Flores was captured on November 20 in a spectacular military operation in Guasave, Sinaloa, Mexico, that also resulted in the arrest of alleged cartel leader German Rolando Galvez Meza, also known as “El Serafin.”
